redaction_self_check.findings: CLEAN — no credential pattern, no long opaque string

proposals_for_phase_0b.keyframe_media_window_threshold: PROPOSAL: require >=10s measured media-clock coverage before any keyframe verdict; below that -> unknown. Derived from: one intra interval measured at 482-576 KB (~1/s); current 16 KiB gate = 2.8% of that.
proposals_for_phase_0b.persistence_ttl: PROPOSAL: >=30 min spanning >=2 separate windows, given measured cache TTL bounds of 17-23s (so windows must be far larger than cache TTL).
proposals_for_phase_0b.normalization_allowlist: PROPOSAL: token, signature, sig, expires, hdnts, session, sid, nonce, _t, cb — each to be confirmed against Phase 0 evidence before locking.
proposals_for_phase_0b.target_environment_matrix: PROPOSAL for owner confirmation: desktop browser; mobile browser (Android, iOS); TV-class device. Basis: the player already special-cases TV/AndroidTV/AFT/SmartTV/BRAVIA/MiBOX/TV Bro user agents.
